notes: 'among whom' gives 'among' to the בְ and 'whom' to אֲשֶׁר, the resumptive suffix going unrepresented under rule 22.

'the sight of the nations' has the rectum rendered arthrously, so its article takes the 'the' standing before its own word and the construct takes a supplied one — rule 29's counting clause, not fronting.
The second lamed on the appositional 'Jacob' is unrepresented, the ASV writing one 'to' for the pair.
